claim: A recursive delete (git worktree remove, rm -rf, Remove-Item -Recurse, rmdir /s) follows a directory junction into its target: removing agent worktrees once wiped the whole local map corpus. Deleting a directory tree is the owner's action.
evidence: 2026-09-01 loss; the owner, 2026-09-02: 'this must never happen again'. Recovery in reports/archive/corpus-recovery-2026-09-01.md.
use: Prefer BLOODMAP_CORPUS and absolute paths to junctions; unlink every reparse point non-recursively before any removal; refresh the corpus backup after a corpus change.
